common_operation.denominator: All supplied incoming nonself edge records; zero-valued hidden/unlabeled neighbors retained.
common_operation.scores: Feature-only detached H Q/K dot product/sqrt64.
common_operation.training_queries: One uniform common Q of k=floor(n/2), removed from every route/head before external mask-independent capture.
common_operation.values: Private learned embeddings of visible permitted TRAIN labels only; V linear/no bias; all other node values zero.
common_operation.zero_visible_label_correction: Exact zero guarded; every value/readout map bias-free.

initializer: Standard full Linear/Embedding reset with isolated explicit per-head CPU seeds; final O/joint O zero. No native/random stream changed by construction contract; runtime unverified.

multihead_single4.backward: One unscaled own CE through all four attention heads and joint output.
multihead_single4.final_selector: One corrected predictor; complete head/readout/native/Adam snapshot.
multihead_single4.joint_readout: Concatenate4 label messages into256 coordinates; fixed bias-free linear256->C, rank <= min(C,256), no activation or tuning.

ordinary_independent4.backbones: External separately initialized full native models/parameters/optimizers required; capture identities are declarations, not proof of actual independence.
ordinary_independent4.backward: Unscaled own CE per ordinary learner; mean own CE reporting only.
ordinary_independent4.final_selector: Four genuinely independent corrected-member selectors, each native+corrector coherent at its own selected epoch; no candidate-selected common epoch.

shared_backbone_untied_correctors4.backward: Own CE/4 per private corrector; mean own CE reported.
shared_backbone_untied_correctors4.final_selector: Mean-probability family; one native state with four coherent correctors at same epoch.

native_integration.backbone_capture: Existing native view B supplied externally; optional native_capture metadata explicitly separates source parameter epoch from live logical native step count.
native_integration.local_restore: Original own-native local selector; coherent learned corrector maps and every owned Adam restored from same own epoch, while mask RNG/steps/counters remain live.
native_integration.ordinary_final: Four member-specific native+corrector selected states; independently selected epochs allowed.
native_integration.shared_final: One pool-selected coherent native+corrector bank state.

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.scaling_limit: Candidate/shared-bank CE/4 and ordinary unscaled own CE are not byte-identical at finite eps. Explicit recipe confound, no numerical equality claim.

parameter_ownership: Each ordinary route/head owns its embedding/Q/K/V. Ordinary prediction routes also own output. Four-head single has one joint output and one Adam. No learned corrector map/embedding or optimizer state shared between ordinary prediction routes.
selection_contract: Explicit policy_sha256/metric_name/VALID and source enums, with common graph/TRAIN/context identities. Module does not implement selection.
serving: mean softmax member probabilities; one prediction for either single.
snapshot_facade: optimizer.state_dict/load_state_dict contains all route Adam states; no native parameters. Four-head single only complete snapshots.
work: Native1+correction4 for shared bank/four-head single; native4+correction4 for ordinary4; four-head single performs one joint backward/Adam. Record attempted/completed counters and external selection/capture/storage costs separately.
